annotations.title: Find artworks, artists, museums or articles by meaning

description: Semantic search returning OBJECTS, not passages: the artworks, artists, museums or articles whose texts are closest in meaning to a text (a question, a paragraph, a section of an article). Each result: model, object_pk (use it with the matching get_detail_* tool), object_title, object_url, best_score (cosine of the object's single best passage; higher is closer), score_sum (its matching passages added up) and matched_vectors_count. rank_by "score_sum" (default) favours objects matching in many passages; "best_score" favours the one passage closest to the text - use it to find the exact work a text is about. Any language works (the texts are in English). Use it when you have a text and want the objects it is about; with a name or keywords, use search_fts; for the passages that answer a question, use search_sections_semantically. Error index_unavailable: fall back to the search_* full-text tools.

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

models.description: Which objects to search (default: artwork, artist, museum).

query.description: The text to find objects for (up to 2000 characters).

rank_by.description: Ranking: sum of the matching passages (default) or the single best one.

name: search_objects_semantically
